description: The line plot illustrates the ROUGE-1 metric performance of different models—T5 + LoRA, MBart + LoRA, T5 + AdaLoRA, and MBart + AdaLoRA—during fine-tuning with varying adapter dimensions (r), as measured on the WikiHow dataset. The x-axis represents the logarithm of r (log r), with values ranging from 0 to 9 on a logarithmic scale, while the y-axis shows the ROUGE-1 score, ranging from 0 to 35. The red line, representing T5 + LoRA, starts at a ROUGE-1 score of approximately 23 when log r = 0 and increases to a peak of about 28.5 at log r = 4, then gradually declines to around 27.2 at log r = 9. The green line, for T5 + AdaLoRA, begins at a ROUGE-1 score of 23.2 and steadily increases to a peak of 35.8 at log r = 4, maintaining this high score through log r = 9. The purple line, corresponding to MBart + LoRA, starts at a ROUGE-1 score of 12.2, drops sharply to a minimum of 5.1 at log r = 1, then rises to a peak of 27.2 at log r = 4, and remains relatively stable around 27.2 until log r = 9. The yellow line, representing MBart + AdaLoRA, begins at a ROUGE-1 score of 12.2, increases to 14.2 at log r = 1, then rises more sharply to a peak of 33.8 at log r = 9. Overall, T5 + AdaLoRA achieves the highest ROUGE-1 scores across the range of log r values, while MBart + LoRA shows the lowest performance, particularly at lower values of log r.
